children.name: Lophiola
children.description: Lophiola — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Lophiola aurea Ker Gawl.
children.description: Lophiola is a genus of monocotyledonous flowering plants native to eastern North America. It has variously been placed in the Liliaceae, the Haemodoraceae, the Tecophilaeaceae or the Nartheciaceae.

children.name: Metanarthecium
children.description: Metanarthecium — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Metanarthecium luteoviride Maxim.
children.description: Metanarthecium is a genus of monocotyledonous flowering plants native to eastern Asia. Its only known species is Metanarthecium luteoviride, known from Japan, Korea, and the Kuril Islands.

children.name: Nietneria
children.description: Nietneria — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Nietneria corymbosa Klotzsch & M.R.Schomb. ex B.D.Jacks.
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Venezuela. It is a perennial or rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Nietneria paniculata Steyerm.
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. Venezuela to W. Guyana and N. Brazil (Serra Aracá). It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Aletris
children.description: Aletris — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Aletris alpestris Diels
children.description: The native range of this species is C. China. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Aletris arabica Deflers, 1889
children.description: Aletris arabica Deflers, 1889 — a liliopsida species in the genus Aletris.

children.name: Aletris aurea Walter
children.description: Aletris aurea (golden unicorn root) is a plant species native to the southeastern United States from eastern Texas and southeastern Oklahoma to Maryland.

children.name: Aletris bracteata Northr.
children.description: Aletris bracteata, the bracted colicroot, is a plant species native to southern Florida (Monroe and Miami-Dade Counties) and to the Bahamas (Andros and Abaco Islands).

children.name: Aletris capitata F.T.Wang & Tang
children.description: The native range of this species is China (C. Sichuan). It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Aletris cinerascens F.T.Wang & Tang
children.description: The native range of this species is China (WC. Yunnan, Guangxi). It is a perennial or rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Aletris dracaenoides Roxb. ex Roem. & Schult., 1829
children.description: Aletris dracaenoides Roxb. ex Roem. & Schult., 1829 — a liliopsida species in the genus Aletris.

children.name: Aletris farinosa L.
children.description: Aletris farinosa, called the unicorn root, true unicorn, crow-corn, white colic-root or white stargrass, is a plant species found across much of the eastern United States.

children.name: Aletris fauriei H.Lév. ex Nakai, 1914
children.description: Aletris fauriei H.Lév. ex Nakai, 1914 — a liliopsida species in the genus Aletris.

children.name: Aletris foliata  Makino & Nemoto
children.description: The native range of this species is Korea, Japan. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Aletris foliolosa Stapf
children.description: The native range of this species is N. Sumatera, N. Borneo, Philippines (Mindoro). It is a perennial and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Aletris foliosa  Bureau & Franch.
children.description: Aletris foliosa  Bureau & Franch. — a liliopsida species in the genus Aletris.

children.name: Aletris glabra Bureau & Franch.
children.description: The native range of this species is Himalaya to China, Taiwan. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Aletris glandulifera Bureau & Franch.
children.description: The native range of this species is C. China. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the subalpine or subarctic biome.

children.name: Aletris gracilis Rendle
children.description: The native range of this species is E. Nepal to China (NW. Yunnan). It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Aletris laxiflora Bureau & Franch.
children.description: The native range of this species is E. Tibet to China (Sichuan, Guizhou). It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Aletris lutea Small
children.description: Aletris lutea (Yellow colic-root) is a plant species native to the southeastern United States from Louisiana to Georgia.

children.name: Aletris megalantha F.T.Wang & Tang
children.description: The native range of this species is China (W. Yunnan). It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Aletris nana S.C.Chen
children.description: The native range of this species is Nepal, S. Tibet, China (NW. Yunnan). It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Aletris obovata Nash
children.description: Aletris obovata (southern colicroot or white colic-root) is a plant species native to the southeastern United States (Mississippi, Alabama, Florida, and Georgia).

children.name: Aletris pauciflora  Hand.-Mazz.
children.description: The native range of this species is Himalaya to SC. China and N. Myanmar. It is a perennial or rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the subalpine or subarctic biome.

children.name: Aletris pedicellata F.T.Wang & Tang
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Sichuan). It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Aletris scopulorum Dunn
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. China, Japan (Shikoku). It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Aletris simpliciflora R.Li & Shu D.Zhang
children.description: The native range of this species is Tibet. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Aletris spec Linnaeus, 1753
children.description: Aletris spec Linnaeus, 1753 — a liliopsida species in the genus Aletris.

children.name: Aletris spicata  Franch.
children.description: The native range of this species is China to SC. & C. Japan and Philippines (N. Luzon). It is a perennial and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Aletris stenoloba Franch.
children.description: The native range of this species is C. & S. China. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Aletris yaanica G.H.Yang
children.description: The native range of this species is China (C. Sichuan). It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Narthecium
children.description: Narthecium — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Narthecium americanum Ker Gawl.
children.description: Narthecium americanum is a species of flowering plant in the Nartheciaceae known by the common names yellow asphodel and bog asphodel.

children.name: Narthecium asiaticum Maxim.
children.description: {{Speciesbox |image = Narthecium asiaticum.JPG |genus = Narthecium |species = asiaticum |authority = Maxim.

children.name: Narthecium balansae Briq.
children.description: The native range of this species is NE. Türkiye to W. Caucasus. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Narthecium californicum Baker
children.description: Narthecium californicum is a species of flowering plant known by the common name California bog asphodel.

children.name: Narthecium montanum  Grey
children.description: The native range of this species is W. North Carolina (Henderson Co.). It is a perennial or rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Narthecium ossifragum  Huds.
children.description: Narthecium ossifragum, commonly known as bog asphodel, Lancashire asphodel or bastard asphodel, is a species of flowering plant in the family Nartheciaceae.

children.name: Narthecium reverchonii Čelak.
children.description: The native range of this species is Corse. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Narthecium scardicum Košanin
children.description: The native range of this species is NE. Albania to NW. Greece. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Narthecium spec  Huds.
children.description: Narthecium spec  Huds. — a liliopsida species in the genus Narthecium.
